# The fast-call slots are plain uintptr, not pins or roots: an object that only
# the slots reference is collected after the call. The runtime test skips unless
# GOEXPERIMENT=logosfastcgo is on, so this script turns the experiment on and
# fails if the test skips or does not run.
[!cgo] skip 'needs cgo'
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env CGO_ENABLED=1
env GOEXPERIMENT=logosfastcgo
go test -v -count=1 -run '^TestLogosFastCgoFrameSlotsAreNotRoots$' runtime
stdout '--- PASS: TestLogosFastCgoFrameSlotsAreNotRoots'
! stdout 'SKIP'
stdout '^ok\s+runtime'
! stderr 'no tests to run'
! stdout 'no tests to run'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/fastcgoslots

go 1.27
